# braintrust_role (Resource)

Manages a custom Braintrust role. Roles are collections of permissions that can be granted via ACLs. Use the `braintrust_role` data source to reference built-in system roles.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the role.
- `member_permissions` (Attributes List) Permissions that belong to this role. Each entry is a (permission, restrict_object_type) tuple. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_permissions))
- `member_roles` (List of String) IDs of roles this role inherits from. An inheriting role has all the permissions of its member roles.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of role creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of role deletion, or null if the role is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the role (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Organization the role belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the role.

<a id="nestedatt--member_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_permissions`

Required:

- `permission` (String) The permission type (create, read, update, delete, create_acls, read_acls, update_acls, delete_acls).

Optional:

- `restrict_object_type` (String) Optionally restricts the permission to a specific object type.
